negative_reviews.author: Gabriele
negative_reviews.text: Fried KFC-style chicken and something they call “ramen”. I’m pretty sure a Japanese grandmother is crying somewhere.

negative_reviews.author: D George
negative_reviews.text: It’s a Nice looking restaurant and comfortable and  the staff are friendly . There’s a good selection of dishes on the menu. The food was tasty but I was expecting slightly better quality

negative_reviews.author: Ri
negative_reviews.text: Went early evening (around 5) when the restaurant was practically empty hoping for good food. I did not rate the food at all. Ended up sending a dish back and getting it redone which showed that the chicken in the original meal sent was burnt (see photos, forgot to take a picture of the chicken when it was redone). Very shy on the amount of chicken too. Bubble tea lemonade was very sweet (but that’s just my taste). Kayleigh was a great host/server. Lovely energy and very helpful. Not sure of the other ladies names but they were all welcoming. Amazing staff, poor food!
